newsitem.title: USA: US crudes end higher in slow Christmas Eve session.
newsitem.headline: US crudes end higher in slow Christmas Eve session.

text.p: U.S. cash crude prices ended a slow Christmas Eve session on the higher side in sympathy with the advances pegged in an abbreviated NYMEX session.
A scarcity of traders was the feature in the pre-holiday market, leaving most domestic grade differentials unswayed.
February West Texas Intermediate closed out at $25.05-15 a barrel, up 30 cents from late Monday due to technical factors. March WTI ended at $24.40-50 a barrel.
NYMEX closed early at 1300 EST/1800 GMT to observe Christmas. ACCESS electronic trading will resume December 25 at 1900 EST/0000 GMT.
